turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The game just asked me to name my village and I've been staring at the box for five minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Naming things is hard! Do you want something funny you'll laugh at every time, or something grand and epic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, which box did you put the kettle in?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The one that says kitchen. Or maybe the one that says misc.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are like six that say misc.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I got a bit lazy with the labels near the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you help me look? I really need a tea.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Start with the small ones. I'll check the ones by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your village still needs a name. Funny or epic?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Puddleton is perfect. It sounds damp and charming.
